Unity 3D Equational Model

One transformer, one vocabulary, every modality — she talks, she draws, she sees, she speaks, she hears. Images and voice are emitted as CDF 9/7 wavelet coefficient fields, never pixels, so vision is the input side of drawing and hearing is the input side of speaking.

Before anything runs — what this machine has

—

⛔ Every check RUNS the thing rather than trusting a file. A requirements.txt that lists torch proves somebody typed it; importing it proves it is installed, for this interpreter, on this machine — and the version it reports is the one that will actually run.
⛔⛔ And torch is two questions, not one. A CPU-only torch imports perfectly, reports a version, and makes the entire run impossible. "installed" and "can train" are different facts and this page says them separately, because collapsing them is the commonest way a machine reads ready and is not.

The road to a finished model

—

⛔ No step is ticked because something ran — every tick is a number on disk, and the number is printed beside it. A pipeline that marks itself complete on exit code 0 is the instrument that lies, which is the failure this whole project is built against.
⚠ Three states, not two. done means measured and past the bar · open means measured and short · unverified means nothing has measured this yet — which is neither of the other two, and collapsing it into either would be reporting health we cannot know.
⛔ Steps marked needs you are judgements, not commands. The automatic run halts on them and no button can sign them off.
